_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.src: Would you like to hear the tale of the pit of the dead?
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.dst: 想聽聽亡者之坑的故事嗎？
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.src: It is the pit where the corpses of the poor miners who discovered the Portal by the {p} are buried.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.dst: 那個坑裡埋的，是當年在 {p} 旁發現傳送門的那些可憐礦工。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.src: Those that had not already died had to be executed due to the insanity brought on from the corruption.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.dst: 沒當場死掉的，也因為腐敗帶來的瘋狂而不得不被處決。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.src: Their spirits still haunt the grave and infect the minds of people who disturb them. It isn't pretty.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.dst: 他們的魂魄至今仍徘徊在那片墳地，侵蝕每個驚擾他們的人的心智。那畫面並不好看。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.src: However, I heard rumours of those who were able to bathe in their waters and be accepted by them, to show no fear of the dead is to be admired.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.dst: 不過我聽過一些傳聞，說有人能浸入那片水中並被他們接納——對亡者毫無懼色，是值得敬佩的。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.src: Maybe this shrine that I keep hearing about has something to do with it? It's apparently hidden deep inside the pit.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.dst: 或許我一直聽人提起的那座神龕跟這有關？據說就藏在坑的深處。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.src: Soldier, the pit is located south east of {p}, across the bridge behind us. I will write down the coordinates inside your quest book.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.dst: 士兵，那個坑在 {p} 的東南方，過了我們身後那座橋就是。我會把座標寫進你的任務書裡。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.src: Enter the pit. Learn it's mysteries, then come back to me.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.dst: 進去吧。弄清楚它的秘密，再回來找我。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#009.src: Explore the pit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the shrine

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.src: Go back to {p} and tell Merloni that you succeeded
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.dst: 回到 {p} 告訴 Merloni 你成功了

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.src: Very impressive! Here's your reward. I found it a while ago while walking around {p}. It probably fell off a skeleton!
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.dst: 了不起！這是你的獎賞。我前陣子在 {p} 附近散步時撿到的，大概是從哪具骷髏身上掉下來的吧！
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.speaker: Merloni
